utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I'll be there for a bit. Just need to take care of a few things first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great. Don't forget to bring any broken appliances you want fixed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I'll see what I can dig up from the garage. Just some small stuff, probably.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've fixed a few tricky ones before, Kira. But I could use an extra pair of hands if you're free.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually going through with this? Did someone get a permit for it, or is this just a neighborhood rumor?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Permit? I didn't think we needed one for a small volunteer repair thing in the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Need a hand with that repair drive? I'm pretty handy with tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Sam, that's wonderful! Actually, we've moved the drive to Sunday at the community center — could you help us patch up the roof there?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Rosa! I've got a ladder and some roofing nails in the truck — I'll head over Sunday morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hana, have you got a clear idea of what needs fixing? I like to have a checklist before I start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm still trying to piece it together, Eli. Did you hear if this is the drive that needs that special calibration I was asking about?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Special calibration? No, I haven't heard anything about that. I just assumed we'd be tightening bolts and patching up the old seesaw.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Opal, are we still on for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Saturday morning at the community center, right? I've got the location marked on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I remember you said nine o'clock. Sam's bringing tools and Jules is handling the electronics—sounds like we're all set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, I'm just trying to figure out if that repair drive kicks off next week or the week after—anyone got the straight scoop?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I think it's next Saturday—the one at the community center, fixing bikes and mowers? But don't quote me on that, my memory's like a sieve.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Next Saturday, got it. I'll swing by if I can. Thanks, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Ira, sorry I'm late—that repair drive's alignment is a real headache. You heard any updates?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No updates yet, Dane—I just know they're setting up Saturday at the community center. Vik mentioned they'll have tools for everything, so maybe swing by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Saturday at the community center, huh? I'll try to get there, but this alignment's got me running behind.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, what's your take on this repair drive? You've been quiet about it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, you know, it's going to be at the community center next Saturday — fixing bikes and mowers, just like Oren said.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds straightforward enough, but do you think we'll actually get enough people to show up?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'd call first—Tess mentioned the flyer was from last Tuesday, so things might have changed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good point, Pia. I can check with Opal to see if the bins are still there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a smart move, Jules. I'd hate for you to drag something heavy over there only to find it's closed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Do you know when it's happening? I keep hearing bits and pieces but nothing solid.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it started last week, but I'm not sure when it ends. Best to call the community center and ask.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, the community center—good idea, I'll give them a ring later today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: So, Faye, are you thinking of helping with the roof repairs too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Honestly, I'm glad if it doesn't mess with school pickup, but roof repairs sound like a whole other headache I'd need to pencil in carefully.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I get that. I thought it was for fixing small appliances at first, but now I know it's for the community center roof. Still figuring out how I can help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive—right, this Saturday. I knew that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Saturday, that's right. Don't forget to swing by for those wrenches before then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I'll definitely grab them before the weekend. I keep forgetting, but I'll make a note this time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Dane! Just wanted to make sure you heard the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, Sunday at the community center—got it. I'll be a bit late, still need to calibrate that alignment.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No rush, Dane! Just glad you can make it. Need any help with that alignment?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, quick question about that repair drive—when's it supposed to start?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's this Saturday at the community center, starting at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh great, so it's this Saturday? Thanks, Leo, I'll try to swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need to borrow any tools for the repair drive? I've got a good set of wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, what's this about a repair drive? I haven't heard much about it yet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's a community thing we're organizing to fix up some houses around the neighborhood. I'm bringing my tool kit—got wrenches, screwdrivers, the works. You're welcome to borrow anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I've heard bits and pieces about it—sounds like a good way to get things fixed and meet folks.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Ira, it's a solid plan if we stick to it. I've got my tools ready, and Gus has spares if anyone needs 'em.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's good to hear, Eli. I was thinking of bringing in that wobbly table of mine—maybe Saturday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? I haven't heard anything official about that. Are you sure?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hmm, Bo was asking about it too—said something about next week or the one after. I'm not sure if it's set in stone yet.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it's still up in the air? I'll believe it when I see a flyer or something official.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Pia, it's this Saturday—we're fixing up old appliances and the community center roof. Have you signed up yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Saturday? I thought it might be next weekend. I should double-check the flyer to make sure I've got the right day before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Pia, take a look at the flyer—I just hope we get enough volunteers, especially for the roof work Rosa mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll bring my own tools, but thanks for offering.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Okay, I'll be here if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate that, Sam. I'll see you Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal! You're just the person I wanted to see. Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? It's going to be a great time—fixing things and chatting over coffee!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'll be there Saturday morning at the community center. I've already got my toolkit ready!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Fantastic! The more the merrier—I'll bring an extra thermos of coffee just for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Jules, what's your take on the repair drive for the playground?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I think you might mean the one Opal's organizing for the community center? It's happening this weekend, bins are set up in the basement. Want me to connect you with her?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, is it for the playground or the community center? I keep hearing different things—what's the real story?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Tess, we're still on for Saturday morning at the community center — I've got the sign-up sheet ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Mara! I'll spread the word to Pia too — she was asking if they're still taking donations.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, that's wonderful, Tess! Tell Pia we're still accepting small appliances and electronics — I've already got a few people lined up to help with repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I actually learned it's for the community center roof, not small appliances. But I'm happy to help out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, the repair drive is for the roof? I thought Leo said to bring broken appliances. Man, I really need to start paying better attention.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I thought the same thing at first. It's easy to mix up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oren, is this the same repair drive that needs special calibration, or a different one?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Special calibration? Hmm, I think I remember something about that... maybe it's the one where we need to tune up the old lawnmowers?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Lawnmowers? I thought it was for electronics. Are we sure about the drive's purpose?
